capabilities: Chat with Claude about vault notes with on-demand file reading and searching
Summarize, rewrite, and translate notes via prompts
Propose note edits and creations as confirmation cards to apply or discard
Scope Claude's access to a note, folder, or the whole vault
Save, append, or copy Claude responses from quick actions
extras: Manual installation only: files must be copied into .obsidian/plugins/ by hand (no community plugin store instructions). Includes a strong disclaimer about sending note content to Anthropic and assumes no liability for costs or data loss. Personal project that does not accept external contributions; iOS/iPadOS needs a full app restart after install.
motivation: The author says most AI tools treat notes as an afterthought, forcing copy-paste round-trips that break flow and lose context, so Claude is given direct vault access instead.
problem: Using AI on notes normally means copying content out to an external tool and pasting results back, which breaks flow, loses vault context, and mangles Markdown.

relations.evidence: Chat with Claude — Anthropic's most capable AI — directly inside Obsidian.

summary: AI chat plugin that lets Claude read, search, and edit vault notes directly, with scoped access and confirmation cards for proposed edits.
